character.name: Panda
character.description: A cute, round, chubby panda bear cub with big black eye patches and fluffy fur, both paws reaching straight up and gripping a bamboo stalk above its head. The bamboo stalk itself is what attaches to a thread near the top of the frame, like a toy clipped on by the bamboo - the thread does not touch the panda body or head directly. The panda dangles below, holding onto the bamboo with both paws, body and legs relaxed.

style: Classic hand-drawn 2D theatrical cartoon style, expressive exaggerated poses, squash-and-stretch animation aesthetics, bold clean outlines, vintage cel shading, playful slapstick character design.
